subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance — retention, logging, PHI/PII
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finservco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft & post-call recap — Data handling / compliance milestone (attached)

Jordan, great to meet today — thanks for the time. Per our discovery call, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the Data handling & compliance milestone. High-level recap and proposed items below.

Quick recap (what we covered):
- Scope: model inference for customer support routing (no model training on customer data).
- Data types: PII in tickets, potential PHI in a small subset of health-related cases (estimated <1% of traffic).
- Requirements: retention controls, detailed audit logs, ability to export/delete data on request, SOC 2 evidence, and contractual PHI restriction if needed.

Proposed MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (draft)
- Target close date: 2026-08-15 (aligned to procurement window)
- Success criteria: documented retention policy agreed, export/delete APIs validated, audit log format & retention confirmed, PHI handling approach (allow list for on-prem/VPC if required) agreed in SOW.
- Responsibilities:
  - FinServCo: provide sample data profiles and prioritized list of PHI/PII fields.
  - Redwood (CS): run validation tests and confirm export/delete flows.
  - Redwood (Security): provide SOC 2 report and audit log samples.
  - Redwood (Legal): draft contract language for PHI / data processing addendum.
- Dependencies: signed SOW, PO, and security review window (2 weeks).

Next steps (from us):
1) Attaching MAP draft v1 and checklist (see attachments).
2) Can you confirm the estimated % of PHI-containing tickets and whether PHI will be in the full payload or only in attachments?
3) If procurement wants a single place for docs, we can upload the finalized MAP and SOC 2 link to the HubSpot deal — will that work?

Attachments: FinServCo-MAP-v1.pdf, MAP-milestone-data-handling-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — I propose we reconvene next week after you share the sample data profile. I cc'd Marissa (CS) to own the validation cadence and Vivek & Lauren for security/legal follow-ups.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finservco.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com, Anita Singh <anita.singh@finservco.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & post-call recap — Data handling / compliance milestone (attached)

Aditya — thanks for the recap and MAP draft. A few clarification questions from our side before we commit to the timeline:

1) PHI: We have a subset of tickets that may contain PHI (insurance/claims). Do you support processing PHI on the hosted Redwood environment, or would we need a private/VPC deployment for any PHI data? If hosted is acceptable, what contractual/technical safeguards do you provide?

2) Retention: Our security policy requires the ability to set variable retention windows per data class (90 days for logs, up to 365 days for case history). Can Redwood support retention configuration per data class and a guaranteed deletion API?

3) Audit logs: We need per-request auditability (who accessed, request payload hash, model version, timestamp). Please confirm the granularity and retention of logs you can provide.

4) Evidence: We will need SOC 2 Type II and either ISO or an internal security questionnaire completed. Send links and an expected turnaround for the questionnaire.

Procurement wants these items clarified before issuing a PO.

Can your security/legal teams provide short answers and any sample artifacts?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Product Security, FinServCo
jordan.lee@finservco.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@finservco.com>, Anita Singh <anita.singh@finservco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft & post-call recap — Data handling / compliance milestone (answers & proposed owners)

Jordan — appreciate the detailed questions. Short answers and proposed next steps below; internal owners are cc'd and will follow up with artifacts.

1) PHI: Redwood does not require private deployment for PHI by default, but we recommend Private (VPC / on-prem) for regulated PHI workloads. We do offer contractual DPA + data processing addendum and will add PHI-specific language in the SOW if you require it. Lauren (Legal) will propose the exact clause and can draft an addendum.

2) Retention: Yes — the platform supports configurable retention policies by data class (logs, tokens, full payload). We provide deletion APIs (immediate deletion requests) and can log deletion events. Marissa (CS) will run a short validation showing configuration UI/API flows.

3) Audit logs: We provide per-request audit logs including timestamp, requester id, model id/version, request/response metadata, and a payload hash. Default retention is 365 days for audit logs in Hosted; retention window can be adjusted for Dedicated/Private. Vivek (Security) will attach a sample log export and retention options.

4) Evidence: We can share SOC 2 Type II, and a standard security questionnaire. Vivek will drop the SOC 2 link and a questionnaire template. Typical turnaround for our completed questionnaire is 3\u20135 business days for an initial pass.

Proposed MAP updates (action items & owners):
- FinServCo: share sample data profile and estimated PHI % (ACTION: Jordan) — due 2026-07-16.
- Redwood (Legal / Lauren): draft PHI addendum language and SOW redline — due 2026-07-20.
- Redwood (Security / Vivek): provide SOC 2 link, sample audit log export, and sample log fields — due 2026-07-16.
- Redwood (CS / Marissa): run retention & deletion validation with sample dataset and confirm API flow — target completion 2026-07-23.
- Procurement (FinServCo): confirm PO timing once items above are validated.

Target milestone close: 2026-08-15 (contingent on SOW and PO). If any of the security/legal items require more time, we will update the MAP timeline accordingly.

Attachments: updated MAP checklist (MAP-milestone-data-handling-checklist.xlsx) — I'll upload the SOC 2 link to the HubSpot deal once Vivek confirms.

Let me know if you'd like a short call to walk through the audit log sample and retention UI — happy to set one up this week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>

Subject: Internal: MAP — data handling milestone (owner check-in & deadlines)

Team — quick internal follow-up from Jordan's questions. Please confirm you can deliver the artifacts by the dates below so I can lock the MAP and share with FinServCo.

- Lauren: PHI addendum draft + SOW redline — due 2026-07-20.
- Marissa: retention & deletion validation (runs on test data we will provide) and short playbook for FinServCo — due 2026-07-23.

Dependencies: Jordan to send sample data profile by 2026-07-16. Target milestone close 2026-08-15 if all deliverables are on schedule. I will update the HubSpot deal and attach artifacts as they arrive: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/2345

If any dates look tight, flag now and we'll negotiate a sliding timeline with the customer.

Thanks — Aditya
